# Beyond Linear Regression Examples

Non-parametric methods that make no assumptions about the underlying functional form: tree-based methods and neighborhood-based methods.

> Slide deck: `d052-beyond-linear-regression.pdf`.

- [01-interpretable-tree.md](/examples/regression/beyond-linear/01-interpretable-tree.md) - `reg_dtree`: regression tree with rule-like splits and easy inspection.
- [10-instance-based-knn.md](/examples/regression/beyond-linear/10-instance-based-knn.md) - `reg_knn`: local prediction by nearby cases.
